P.name: Rebirth
P.title: Template:Data Anivia/Rebirth
P.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Rebirth|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Anivia
|skill        = I
|icon         = Rebirth.png
|description  = {{sbc|Innate:}} Periodically, upon taking {{tip|death|fatal damage}}, '''Anivia''' enters {{tip|resurrection}} for 6 seconds and restores all of her {{sti|{{as|health}}}}.
|description2 = While under resurrection, '''Anivia''' is {{tip|lockout|unable to act}} and gains {{pp|-40 to 20 for 5|1;5;8;12;15|changedisplay=true}} {{sti|armor|{{as|'''bonus''' armor}}}} and {{sti|mr|{{as|'''bonus''' magic resistance}}}}.
|description3 = If '''Anivia''' remains alive by the end of the duration, she is revived with her {{as|'''current''' health}}.
|static       = 240
|targeting    = Passive
|affects      = Self
|notes        = 
* Triggering ''Rebirth'' will break {{tip|tether|tethers}} on '''Anivia'''.
* {{ai|Chronoshift|Zilean}} and {{ii|Guardian Angel}} will take priority over ''Rebirth''.
* If ''Rebirth'' triggers while '''Anivia''' is channeling {{si|Teleport}}, her channel won't be interrupted.
** All other {{tip|channel|channels}} will be interrupted upon triggering ''Rebirth''.
* The following refers for interactions while '''Anivia''' is resurrecting:
{{ct|move=false|cast=false|attack=false|items=false|consume=false|spells=false|interrupts=death}}
<!-- Blurb -->
|blurb        = {{sbc|Innate:}} Periodically, upon {{tip|death|dying}}, {{ci|Anivia}} will instead revert into an egg. If the egg can survive for a few seconds, she is gloriously {{tip|resurrection|reborn}}.
}}

Q.name: Flash Frost
Q.title: Template:Data Anivia/Flash Frost
Q.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Flash Frost|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Anivia
|skill        = Q
|icon         = Flash Frost.png
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Anivia''' launches a chunk of ice in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|slow|slows}} them by {{pp|changedisplay=true|key=%|20;20 to 40 for 3|0 to 3|type = [[File:Glacial Storm.png|20px|border|link=]] ''Glacial Storm's'' Rank|formula = 20% + (10% * (''Glacial Storm's'' rank - 1))}} for 3 seconds.
|leveling     = {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|50 to 130}} {{as|(+ 25% AP)}}}}
|description2 = ''Flash Frost'' can be recast while the ice is in flight after its cast time, and does so automatically at maximum range.
|description3 = {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Anivia''' shatters the ice, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies and {{tip|stun|stunning}} them for a duration, as well as refreshing the {{tip|slow}}.
|leveling3    = {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|60 to 200}} {{as|(+ 45% AP)}}|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|50+60 to 130+200}} {{as|(+ {{ap|45+25}}% AP)}}}}
{{st|Stun Duration|{{ap|1.1 to 1.5}} seconds}}
|range        = {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} 1100
|effect radius= {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} 225
|width        = {{tip|er|icononly = true}} 220
|speed        = 950
|cooldown     = {{ap|11 to 7}}
|cdstart      = post-effect
|cast time    = {{fd|0.25}}
|cost         = {{ap|80 to 100}}
|costtype     = mana
|targeting    = [[Direction-targeted|Direction]] / [[Auto-targeted|Auto]]
|affects      = Enemies
|damagetype   = Magic
|spellshield  = Special
|spelleffects = spellaoe
|projectile   = True
|notes        = 
*The initial cast and the manual recast count as ability activations for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.
** If the ability is not manually recasted, the secondary effect will trigger without being considered as an ability activation.
* ''Flash Frost'' will fire from wherever '''Anivia''' was at the start of the cast time.
* {{tip|Spell shield}} can block the effects of either the active or the recast, but not both if the former is blocked.
<!-- Blurb -->
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Anivia}} launches a chunk of ice that deals {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|slows}} enemies hit.
|blurb2       = ''Flash Frost'' will recast at max range, or can recast early.
|blurb3       = {{sbc|Recast:}} The ice explodes, dealing {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|stun|stunning}} nearby enemies.
}}

W.name: Crystallize
W.title: Template:Data Anivia/Crystallize
W.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Crystallize|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Anivia
|skill        = W
|icon         = Crystallize.png
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Anivia''' summons a wall of ice at the target location perpendicular to her facing, {{tip|airborne|knocking}} all units away from it, though not through terrain. The wall lingers as impassable terrain for 5 seconds.
|leveling     = {{st|{{tt|Width|Pathfinding}}|{{tip|pathing radius|icononly = true}} {{ap|600 to 1000}} units}}
{{st|Number of ice segments|{{ap|4 to 8}} chunks of ice|Distance between outermost segments|{{ap|400 to 800}} units|Distance between individual segments|{{ap|133.33|125|120|116.67|114.29}} units}}
|target range = {{dv|{{tt|1000|Maximum cast range for wall center}}|{{tt|100|Minimum cast range}}}}
|cooldown     = 17
|cost         = 70
|costtype     = mana
|cast time    = {{fd|0.25}}
|targeting    = Location
|affects      = Enemies
|spellshield  = false
|outofrange   = walk to location
|notes        = 
* ''Crystallize's'' displacement triggers in-combat effects by dealing 0 {{tip|proc damage|proc}} {{tip|true damage}}, such as drawing turret aggro, {{ri|Sudden Impact}} and applying {{ii|Elixir of Sorcery}}.
* Individual ice chunks have both 100 units {{tip|pathing radius}} and {{tip|gameplay radius}}.
* {{tip|champion|Champions}} are knocked 120 units to either side of a wall segment, non-champions 250 units.
** {{pending for test}} Knockback speed?
* Player-generated terrain such as ''Crystallize'' does not block {{tip|sight}}.
<!-- Blurb -->
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Anivia}} {{tip|airborne|erects}} a wall of ice that lingers for a few seconds, blocking movement.
}}

E.name: Frostbite
E.title: Template:Data Anivia/Frostbite
E.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Frostbite|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Anivia
|skill        = E
|icon         = false
|description  = {{sbc|Passive:}} Enemies hit by ''{{ai|Flash Frost|Anivia}}'' or a fully formed ''{{ai|Glacial Storm|Anivia}}'' become ''Iced'' for 3 seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits.
|icon2        = Frostbite.png
|description2 = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Anivia''' blasts a freezing wind at the target enemy that deals {{as|magic damage}}, {{ccs|doubled|magic}} if they were ''Iced''.
|leveling2    = {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|55 to 155}} {{as|(+ 55% AP)}}|Enhanced Damage|{{ap|55*2 to 155*2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|55*2}}% AP)}}}}
|target range = {{tip|er|icononly = true}} 600
|cooldown     = 4
|cost         = 50
|costtype     = mana
|speed        = 1600
|targeting    = Unit
|cast time    = {{fd|0.25}}
|affects      = Enemies
|damagetype   = Magic
|spellshield  = True
|spelleffects = spell
|projectile   = True
|callforhelp  = True
|notes        = 
* The damage of ''Frostbite'' is calculated once it hits. If the target's mark from being hit by {{ai|Flash Frost|Anivia}} or a fully formed {{ai|Glacial Storm|Anivia}} wears off while the projectile is traveling, the damage is not doubled.
* ''Frostbite'' has a different sound effect when it hits a target for double damage.
{{Unit-targeted cancel conditions}}
<!-- Blurb -->
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Anivia}} blasts a freezing wind at the target enemy that deals {{as|magic damage}}.
|blurb2       = If the target had been recently hit by ''{{ai|Flash Frost|Anivia}}'' or ''{{ai|Glacial Storm|Anivia}}'', the damage is {{ccs|doubled|magic}}.
}}

R.name: Glacial Storm
R.title: Template:Data Anivia/Glacial Storm
R.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Glacial Storm|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Anivia
|skill        = R
|icon         = false
|icon2        = Glacial Storm.png
|description  = {{sbc|Passive:}} ''{{ais|Flash Frost|Anivia}}'' {{tip|slow}} strength is increased.
|leveling     = {{st|Slow Strength Increase|{{ap|0 to 20}}%}}
|description2 = {{sbc|Toggle:}} '''Anivia''' calls forth a driving rain of ice and hail at the target location, dealing {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.5}} seconds to enemies within and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them for 1 second, refreshing every {{fd|0.5}} seconds while they remain inside.
|leveling2    = {{st|Magic Damage per Tick|{{ap|15 to 30}} {{as|(+ {{fd|6.25}}% AP)}}}}
{{st|Slow|{{ap|20 to 40}}%}}
|description3 = The blizzard increases in size over {{fd|1.5}} seconds. At maximum size, ''Glacial Storm'' is empowered to deal 300% damage and increase the effectiveness of its slow by 50%, which also instead lasts {{fd|1.5}} seconds and refreshes every {{fd|0.25}} seconds.
|leveling3    = {{st|Empowered Damage per Tick|{{ap|15*3 to 30*3}} {{as|(+ {{ap|6.25*3}}% AP)}}}}
{{st|Empowered Slow|{{ap|20*1.5 to 40*1.5}}%}}
|description4 = Toggling ''Glacial Storm'' off triggers a final tick of damage and incurs its full cooldown. ''Glacial Storm'' is toggled off automatically if '''Anivia''' moves too far away from the blizzard or becomes unable to pay the {{sti|{{as|mana}}}} cost, or is affected by any form of {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control}}.
|target range = 750
|cast time    = none
|effect radius= {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{pp|type=time active|200 to 400 by 25;400|0 to 1.5;1.5+}}
|tether radius= 1000
|cooldown     = {{tt|{{ap|4 to 2}}|Starts after storm disappears}}
|cdstart      = post-effect
|static       = 1
|cost         = 60
|costtype     = mana{{plus}}{{ap|35 to 55 3}} per second
|targeting    = [[Location-targeted|Location]] / [[Auto-targeted|Auto]]
|affects      = Enemies
|damagetype   = Magic
|spellshield  = False
|spelleffects = aoedot
|silence      = true
|outofrange   = Walk in range of the target location to cast (first cast)
|notes        = 
* Toggled abilities do not count as ability activations for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.
* ''Glacial Storm's'' slow leaves a trail that is visible even if the target is [[stealth]]ed.
* ''Glacial Storm'' deals 3 half ticks at {{ap|200|267|333}} radius for a total of {{fd|1.5}} normal damage ticks before it starts dealing empowered damage at 400 radius.
* {{tip|Stasis (buff)|Stasis}} via {{ii|Zhonya's Hourglass}} doesn't interrupt ''Glacial Storm''.
** {{cai|Devour|Tahm Kench}} '''does''' interrupt (allied and enemy) ''Glacial Storm''.
<!-- Blurb -->
|blurb        = {{sbc|Passive:}} {{ais|Flash Frost|Anivia}} {{tip|slow}} is increased.
|blurb2       = {{sbc|Toggle:}} {{ci|Anivia}} summons a driving rain of ice and hail at the target location that continually deals {{tip|magic damage}} and {{tip|slow|slows}} enemies within.
|blurb3       = ''Glacial Storm'' is deactivated when '''Anivia''' leaves it or gets hit by {{tip|crowd control|disables}}.
}}
